Nem csak a száraz környezetekben, hanem a nedves és meleg esőerdőkben is. Ma mintegy 1500 skorpiófajt ismerünk, és bárhol éljenek is, egyvalami közös bennük: kerülik a fényt, nappal szunyókálnak, és szinte mozdulatlanul fekszenek egészen alkonyatig.

programme.title: Sztankay mozija
programme.desc: Az M5 filmklubja, amelyben Sztankay Ádám és vendégei hétről hétre benéznek a filmkockák mögé.

programme.title: A hentes
programme.desc: Egy kisvárosi hentes, Popaul megismerkedik Hélene-nel a tanítónővel egy ismerős pár lakodalmán. Ismeretségükből mély barátság alakul ki. A kisvárost egy sorozatgyilkos tartja rettegésben: a környéken fiatal lányokat szurkálnak halálra. Hélene az osztályával kirándulni megy az erdőbe. Hirtelen a fiatal feleség holttestére bukkannak, akit nemrégiben szúrtak agyon. Legnagyobb döbbenetére a holttest mellett megtalálja azt az öngyújtót, amelyet korábban ő ajándékozott Popaul-nak. A nyomozónak nem árulja el titkát...

programme.title: Librettó
programme.desc: Kritika, művészek, kulissza. Minden, ami a kultúrában történik.

programme.title: Jó reggelt, Anya!
programme.desc: Anna kezdi visszaszerezni pozícióját a családban, de ez nem megy könnyen. Összetűzésbe kerül mind Jacopóval, mind Francescával, mert nem ért egyet a viselkedésükkel. Agata féltékenyen szemléli a család szoros kapcsolatát, úgy érzi, nincs már ott helye, ezért fogja a holmiját és elmegy Mauróhoz. Colaprico közli Agatával, hogy minden Mauriziával kapcsolatos anyagot kidob, megkéri a lányt, hogy törölje a számát. De ekkor egy újabb dolgot fedez fel a holmik között a babában: egy kulcsot a Binsky Pointhoz, Saveriónak, Mauro apjának farmjához.

programme.title: Agenda
programme.desc: Hírek, aktualitások a kultúra, a tudomány és az oktatás területéről.

programme.title: Századfordító magyarok
programme.desc: Schaár Erzsébet a XX. századi magyar szobrászat jelentős művésze. Alkotásai már a készület idején megelőzték korukat, semmilyen izmushoz nem sorolhatók. Művei a kor emberének érzésvilágát: a szorongást, a magányosságot tükrözik, sokszor sok iróniával, mondhatni humorral is. Életéről, alkotói módszereiről beszélnek barátai, fia és műtörténészek.

programme.title: M5 História
programme.desc: Városok, közösségek és hétköznapi emberek története. Az M5 História új helytörténeti sorozata egy-egy település történetén keresztül mutatja be a történelmünk meghatározó fordulópontjait. Helyi emlékek, épületek, dokumentumok segítségével azt kutatjuk, hogyan érkeztek meg a nemzet nagy eseményei a mindennapokba.

programme.title: Magyar Krónika
programme.desc: Feltételül tűzöm ki, hogy legfölebb négy év alatt a magyar nyelvet annyira elsajátítsa, hogy azt tannyelvül használhassa és azon előadásokat tarthasson. Írta 1877-ben Trefort Ágoston miniszter az ifjú Kaufmann Dávid tudós rabbi kinevezéshez, aki kiválóan megtanult magyarul, és Budapesten élte le az életét hátrahagyva egy felbecsülhetetlen értékű gyűjteményt, amelyet a Magyar Tudományos Akadémián őriznek. Csodás tárgyak a Magyar Krónikában.

programme.title: Erdei utakon
programme.desc: Reviczky Gábor, a Kossuth-díjas színművész-műsorvezető hétről hétre megismerteti a nézőket a hazai és külhoni erdőkkel vagy az azok környékén zajló legfontosabb eseményekkel. Közelebb kerülhetünk az erdészek, vadászok, természetvédők életéhez. Bejárhatjuk a legszebb tájakat és megismerhetünk olyan embereket, akiknek élete, munkája szinte egybefonódik a természettel és erdeink életével. Tartsanak velünk és lépjenek ki Reviczky Gáborral a mindennapok mókuskerekéből vissza a természetbe!

programme.title: Kontúr
programme.desc: PÉLDÁK, SORSOK, TITKOK, VALLOMÁSOK - Mélyinterjúk a kulturális élet meghatározó személyiségeivel az M5 műsorán.

programme.title: Kerekek és lépések
programme.desc: A szabadkígyósi kastély és a kétegyházi román tájház az első két megállónk, majd a Körös-parti Gyula sok és különleges látnivalója következik.

programme.title: Lyukasóra
programme.desc: A Duna Televízió stúdiójában jönnek össze a Lyukasóra irodalomrajongó barátai, hogy játsszanak, és megörvendeztessék egymást választott kedvenc idézeteikkel. A játszótársak: Lator László, Ráckevei Anna, Kubik Anna, Faragó Laura, Várady Szabolcs és Lackfi János. Mészöly Dezső feladványát felvételen küldi el társainak.

programme.title: Vers mindenkinek
programme.desc: Arany János Itthon című versét Hűvösvölgyi Ildikó adja elő.

programme.title: Múzeumtúra
programme.desc: Az Orsay múzeum egy átalakított, korábban lebontásra ítélt vasútállomás épületében található a Szajna partján. Az átalakítási munkálatok 1986-ra fejeződtek be. A hatalmas terek, és a fény rendkívül érdekes kulisszát teremtenek a műveknek. Olyan művészek alkotásai vannak itt, mint Monet, Manet, Renoir, Cézanne, Pisarro, vagy Van Gogh.

programme.title: Aranycsapat
programme.desc: A film az úgynevezett Aranycsapatról szól, arról a labdarúgó válogatottról, amely az ötvenes évek elején vitathatatlanul a világ legjobb együttese volt és sok dicsőséget szerzett a magyar sportnak. A film a csapat kialakulásának, legjobbak közé jutásának, világra szóló sikereinek, világbajnoki kudarcának, majd széthullásának történetét meséli el. Az utolsó jeleneteknek megrendítő erejük van. A világhírű Puskás Öcsi 25 év múltán tér vissza Magyarországra, és régi csapattársaival újra játszik a Népstadion gyepén, megannyi sikerük helyszínén. Teltház, szólnak a trombiták és a dobok, zászlók lengenek, amikor az Aranycsapat tagjai kifutnak a pályára….

programme.title: Az erdők megmentése
programme.desc: Az India és Banglades területén található Szundarbansz ad otthont a világ legnagyobb mangrove erdejének. Nincs még egy olyan fa, amely ilyen jól tudna alkalmazkodni a változó természeti körülményekhez: a sós és édesvízhez, az apályhoz és dagályhoz. Ennek ellenére a mértéktelen halászás, a ráktenyésztés és a globális felmelegedés itt is érezteti hatását. Az Unesco és a bangladeshi kormány mindent elkövet, hogy a két csúcsragadozó, a bengáli tigris és a krokodil, valamint a mangrove erdők fennmaradjanak...

programme.title: Multiverzum
programme.desc: A Multiverzum a tudományos eredmények- és kalandok műsora. Rendszeresen beszámol a magyar tudományos közélet eredményeiről, ugyanakkor nem feledi azt sem, hogy a tudomány történései a szélesebb közönség számára csak abban az esetben izgalmasak, ha azok a nézők nyelvén szólalnak meg. A Multiverzumot ezért minden érdekli, ami tudomány: tartalmai között jelen vannak az orvoslás legfrissebb kutatásai, a bioetika kérdései vagy a hétköznapi fantasztikum témái. A Multiverzum ilyen értelemben az érdeklődő polihisztorok magazinja, akik nem riadnak el a komolyabb tartalmaktól, ugyanakkor keresik a rendhagyó, ám igényes témákat.

programme.title: Koronás sas
programme.desc: Anna Cudkának panaszkodik amiatt, mert Kázmérral megromlott a viszonya. A csuklyás felfedi kilétét Trzebornak és ketten megfogadják, hogy bosszút állnak Jasieken az őket ért sérelmek miatt. Spytek megtiltja Giovanninak, hogy találkozzon Jagnával. A kocsmáros megkéri Egle kezét, aki kineveti az öreg fogadóst. Cudka panaszkodik Kázmérnál, hogy állandóan követségben van a férje...

programme.title: Kerekek és lépések

programme.title: Utazások Skócia szigetein
programme.desc: Paul Murton ezúttal az Edinburgh közeli torkolatöböl, a Forth kis szigeteit járja be, amelyek erődökkel védték a keleti partvidéket. A látnivalók között akad pompás vasúti híd, középkori templom, erődítményrendszer, hajóroncs, zord várbörtön és a világ egyik legnagyobb tengeri szula-telepe.

programme.title: Daliás idők
programme.desc: A magyar irodalom egyik legnagyobb elbeszélő költeménye, Arany János Toldija nyomán készítette el Gémes József ezt a különleges festménytechnikával készült, különös hangulatú, többszörös díjnyertes animációs filmjét. A film művészi látomásokon keresztül mutatja be Magyarország középkori lovagi életét, az alkotók által kidolgozott, műfajteremtően egyedi módszerrel.

programme.title: Édes anyanyelvünk
programme.desc: Úgy tartják, hogy Móricz Zsigmond Rózsa Sándora a magyar irodalom egyik legtökéletesebben megformált paraszti alakja. A Rózsa Sándor-regények nem csak az elmúlt idők betyárvilágát mutatják be, hanem az akkor Szeged környékén élők nyelvjárási jellemzőit is. Németh Miklós nyelvész a vendégünk.

programme.title: Univerzum
programme.desc: A vízi közlekedés elválaszthatatlanul összeforr a Wörthi-tó múltjával. Évente akár 175 000 turista is utazhat a különböző méretű csónakokon és hajókon. A kereskedelmi célú hajózás 1853-ban kezdődött itt, amikor Eduard von Herbert báró megalapította a tó első gőzhajózási társaságát. A Wörthi-tó régi híres hajói, a Neptune, a Helios és a Thalia közül már csak ez utóbbi maradt fenn. Ez az egyik utolsó propelleres gőzhajó Európában. Ausztria egyik legnagyobb és legnépszerűbb fürdőzésre alkalmas tava, de hírneve nem csak ezen alapul. Több mint száz éve mágnesként vonzza a művészetet és a művészeket, akik a tájért jöttek, és egyedülálló építészeti alkotásokat hagytak hátra. Ennek a tónak nincs párja, mert itt az ember találkozik a természettel.

programme.title: Magyar Krónika
programme.desc: Szent hely, szent az öreg miatt, kinek ott van háza és sírhalma. Kötelessége volna minden emelkedettebb lelkű magyarnak életében legalább egyszer oda elzarándokolnia. Petőfi Sándor írta ezt Kazinczy Ferenc otthonáról. A nyelvújító egykori gyümölcsöskertjének helyén ma már a magyar nyelv múzeuma áll, de hogy mit mutathat meg egy múzeum az anyanyelvről? A magyar krónika magyar nyelv napi adásából kiderül.

programme.title: Multiverzum

programme.title: Koronás sas
programme.desc: Cudka úgy dönt, hogy hazamegy, mielőtt kísértésbe esne, hogy közelebb kerüljön Kázmérhoz. Miközben Jagna kétségbeesetten próbál megoldást találni szíve gondjára, Giovanni megsértődik rá, amiért nem ment el a titkos találkára. Spytek azt javasolja Kázmérnak, hogy kössön örökösödési szerződést lányai kérőivel. Az udvarba új udvarhölgy érkezik, aki Jagnát kivéve mindenkit elbűvöl. Jasiek hazatértekor veszi észre, hogy fia és a dajkája eltűntek.

programme.title: A természet magyar fotósai
programme.desc: Magyar természetfotósok. Közös céljukat mindegyikük sajátos, egyedi alkotóként közelítik meg. Miért pont azt és pont úgy láttatják képeiken? Hogyan választják ki témáikat, helyszíneiket? Hogy készülnek egy-egy fotóstúrára? Spontaneitás vagy hosszas előkészület határozza meg munkájukat? Miért tartják fontosnak a természet megismertetését, megszerettetését? Hogyan egyeztethető össze természet és művészet? A portréfilmek 5 percbe, egy rövid filmpillanatba - ahogy ők egy képkockába - sűríti alkotói személyiségüket, az általuk szeretett természeti értékeket, tájakat, elkísérve őket egy-egy fotós napra.

programme.title: Dinoszauruszok, a Föld urai
programme.desc: Körülbelül 66 millió évvel ezelőtt különös élőlények uralták a világunkat: a dinoszauruszok. A legnagyobb állatok voltak, akik valaha a Földön éltek. A szakértők ma a világ minden táján kutatják a csontjaikat. Hála nekik, sok mindent megtudhatunk, eme rendkívüli lényekről, és úgy mesélhetünk róluk, mintha még ma is köztünk élnének. Az első rész tartalmából: Egy elárvult Triceratops kölyöknek túl kell járnia egy halálos T-rex eszén. Vajon sikerül túlélnie?

programme.title: Édes anyanyelvünk

Vendégei nyelvészek, akik ismeretterjesztő formában segítenek a műsorvezetőnek és a nézőknek megérteni, hogy miként tudunk érthetően, helyesen, pontosan beszélni és fogalmazni magyarul.

programme.title: Történelmi rangadó

programme.title: Örökség
programme.desc: Szilvia dúsgazdag, de házassága Ákossal gyermektelen. Vagyonát és befolyását imádott férje karrierjének egyengetésére használja. Szilvia arra vágyik, hogy Ákos gyermeke örökölje a vagyont, és tegye teljessé életüket. Körmönfontan ráveszi a szép és intelligens, de szegény Irént, hogy megszülje Ákos gyermekét. Számításába azonban hiba csúszik, a lány és Ákos egymásba szeretnek. De Szilviát nem lehet legyőzni… A filmet beválogatták az 1980-as Cannes-i Filmfesztivál versenyprogramjába. A főbb szerepekben Isabelle Huppert, Monori Lili, Jan Nowicki és Perczel Zita látható.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: There's lots to celebrate this time around! Not only is it Geordie Shore's 15th anniversary but Chloe Ferry's also turning 30! To celebrate, trip organizer Nathan Henry leads the way as the party heads to Europe, where the crew meet up in Lisbon, Portugal, for the mother of all city breaks. They go sightseeing, enjoy rooftop bars, eat in some incredible restaurants, dance in beach bars, nightclubs and street parties and soak up all the culture Lisbon has to offer. There's also a Geordie blast from the past because after many years, best mates Aaron Chalmers and Gary Beadle return to join in with the celebrations. But will a public feud, seeing harsh and personal comments being shared online between James Tindale and Ricci Guarnaccio, with Leah, Kyle and Jay also becoming involved, spill into the villa and put a dampener on all the festivities? Will the beef cause an even bigger divide between the various friendship groups within the family? And will Chloe's 30th be forever scarred by the warring Geordies.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: The Geordie's are back! Marnie Simpson is getting married, Holly Hagan is pregnant, Charlotte Crosby is starting her motherhood journey, and Sophie's got a new boyfriend. After Marnie and Casey's wedding day, they decide to invite the entire Geordie Shore family on their honeymoon to Cyprus...a family vacay where all kids, partners, and one or two nannas are invited along. The trip heats up quickly when friendships and loyalties are tested. After Chloe drunkenly voiced opinions about Charlotte at Marnie's wedding, there is friction in the air after Charlotte finds out. Tensions reach boiling point in Cyprus when the mess in the family villa becomes too much for Charlotte, leading to hers and Marnie's biggest fallout ever. The argument erupts within the villa and leaves one Geordie questioning whether to leave the holiday for good. Arriving back after the Geordie Moon, there's a leaving party for one Geordie, a baby shower for another, and some uncomfortable conversations following the Cyprus drama fallout.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.title: Golden Stage
programme.desc: The Golden Stage brings together the crème de la crème of avant-garde hip-hop dancers. The Golden Stage plateau International hip-hop brings together the cream of the avant-garde hip-hop scene at the Grande Halle de la Villette. It's a hard-hitting evening of four short shows (twenty minutes each, with stand-up Nick Mukoko as master of ceremonies this year), highlighting hip-hop dance in all its virtuosity, audacity and, above all, diversity, by programming more underground trends that are not usually represented on institutional stages.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons: A Ballet By David Nixon Era CBE
programme.desc: In 18th century France, letters fly between the mansions of two bored aristocrats as they spin a web of heartbreak and ruin. It might seem like a game, but lives will be ruined and love irrevocably lost. From the original scandalous novel, the acclaimed film starring John Malkovich and Michelle Pfeiffer and iconic retelling Cruel Intentions, this dangerous story has been thrilling audiences for over 200 years. Northern Ballet's bodice-ripping adaptation is set to Vivaldi's The Four Seasons, played live by Northern Ballet Sinfonia. You'll feel every heartbeat of this intimate performance.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim Crossing Borders: Music And Politics
programme.desc: Daniel Barenboim is constantly trying to find out what music can achieve and how it can inspire mankind. The first part of this documentary therefore focuses on the political impact of music and investigates whether it can be a means to overcome cultural differences. Thus it depicts UN Messenger of Peace Daniel Barenboim leading a spectacular concert in Gaza in May 2011, working with the West-Eastern-Divan Orchestra or travelling to Egypt and conducting for the first time ever the Cairo Symphony Orchestra. It features Barenboim discussing music and politics and other prominent figures of contemporary history such as Pierre Boulez, Joschka Fischer, Richard von Weizsäcker and others.

programme.title: Instinct
programme.desc: Three fighters, one vital resource, no room for compromise. "Instinct" is a tense, physically charged short dance film built around a single life-or-death struggle. As the dancers clash over water, their movement becomes a test of endurance, urgency, and survival. Their movements are sharp, stripped-back, and unflinching. Bodies strain, collide, and resist, mirroring the brutal realities of scarcity and entitlement. Every action carries consequences, and every choice exposes what desperation can bring in each of us. With a stark visual language and urgent momentum, this is a gripping meditation on survival, power, and the cost of getting what we need.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Crossing Borders: Living with Music
programme.desc: In the second part, conductor and pianist Barenboim comes to the heart of music and investigates its phenomenology. He sketches how a score becomes music during rehearsals with the Staatskappelle Berlin, delineates the sublimity and richness of sound in a workshop about chamber music or demonstrates at the grand piano boundless ways of expression.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Crossing Borders: Wagner - Music and Taboo
programme.desc: The third part focuses on Richard Wagner in reference to his taboo in Israel. Daniel Barenboim addresses the question whether music as an art form can be judged from a purely musical perspective or if it can't be separated from the views and beliefs of its creator.

programme.title: Matthew Bourne's The Red Shoes
programme.desc: Filmed at Sadler's Wells in 2019, Matthew Bourne's The Red Shoes is a triumphant adaptation of the legendary 1948 feature film by Micheal Powell and Emeric Pressburger. The double Olivier Award-winning show is Hans Christian Andersen's tale of obsession, possession, and one girl's dream to be the greatest dancer in the world. Victoria Page, played by Ashley Shaw - winner of a National Dance Award for her performance - lives to dance, but her ambitions become a battleground between the two men who inspire her passion: composer Julian Craster played by original cast member Dominic North, and legendary impresario Boris Lermontov, performed by the great Adam Cooper. Set to the achingly romantic music of golden-age Hollywood composer Bernard Herrmann, The Red Shoes is orchestrated by Terry Davies and performed live by the New Adventures Orchestra, with cinematic designs by Lez Brotherston, lighting by Paule Constable, sound by Paul Groothuis, and projection by Duncan McLean. The Red Shoes will dazzle your senses and break your heart.

programme.title: Golden Stage

programme.title: Una Notte a Napoli
programme.desc: Set to music by Pink Martini, "Una Notte a Napoli" ( A Night in Napoli) is a playful and cinematic dance film that is delightfully whimsical, romantic, and just a little bit strange. Directed and choreographed by Lucia Lopez Sanchez, the film flows with a teasing charm, leading us through a story that hints of mystery, mischief, and fleeting joys without ever fully revealing its secrets. Every gesture and sequence is an unmissable balance of humor and drama. A cinematic delight, "Una Notte a Napoli" celebrates the joy, impermanence, and playful strangeness of everyday life.

programme.title: Tempest
programme.desc: "Tempest," starring Agnes Su of Stuttgart Ballet, is a mesmerizing dance film that captures the delicate tension between aspiration and self-acceptance. With stark simplicity and emotional honesty, Su's performance embodies the beauty and struggle of striving for perfection, revealing the quiet moments where vulnerability and grace meet. Elegant, intimate, and very moving, "Tempest" is a celebration of the artistry in imperfection and the courage it takes to dance on your own terms.

programme.title: Move to Live with Akram Khan
programme.desc: Olivier Award-winning Actress and Director Kathryn Hunter is renowned for her work with physical theatre, notably with the pioneering theatre company Complicité, co-founded by her late husband Marcello Magni. She talks to Akram about her work with Marcello and how movement has always been a cornerstone of her approach to acting. Shakespeare has also been a cornerstone of Kathryn's career and she discusses her approach to playing the "Everest" of roles, King Lear, in two different productions spanning a 25-year timeframe. She also talks about how different stages make her move differently and recalls how screenwriter Joel Cohen wanted her to combine the physicality of a crow combined with a standing stone for his film The Tragedy of Macbeth. And Kathryn tells Akram how a serious accident left her with life-changing injuries but how this resulted in her thinking anew about how she could communicate physically.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 27, Op. 90
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. Daniel Barenboim is one such pianist - his recordings run the gamut from Bach and Mozart to Bruckner and Bartók. In following in the footsteps of such masters as Artur Schnabel, Barenboim truly shows himself to be among the greatest living musicians.

programme.title: Benjamin Grosvenor Plays Mozart
programme.desc: Two contrasting masterpieces take center stage in this brilliant concert from the London Philharmonic Orchestra conducted by Andrey Boreyko. Acclaimed British pianist Benjamin Grosvenor brings what Seen and Heard International described as an "understated lightness of touch" to Mozart's Piano Concerto No.21. This beloved work is the epitome of regal elegance, especially in the slow movement, which Grosvenor shapes with the radiance and fluidity of a "waterfall sparking in sunshine." Written during a period of extreme personal turmoil, Tchaikovsky's Symphony No.4 is an exploration of the inescapable force of fate. It opens wth a powerful brass fanfare, representing fate, which is echoed throughout the piece. As the composer explained in a letter, this musical "kernel" is "the fatal power which prevents one from attaining the goal of happiness ... There is nothing to be done but to submit to it." From brooding introspection to unbounded joy, the work charts an emotional journey of struggle and triumph. Together, Boreyko, Grosvenor, and the LPO give an unforgettable concert that will stay with you long after the final note. Program: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 21, K467 * Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 *Benjamin Grosvenor, Piano Please note: Benjamin Grosvenor's performance of Mozart's Piano Concerto will be available to stream on Marquee TV until 25 August 2025, 7.00 pm (GMT). This performance will then appear as "Sibelius & Tchaikovsky." Additional note about credit: Benjamin Grosvenor appears courtesy of Decca Records.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Berliner Philharmoniker - Britten / Bruckner 9
programme.desc: "Night" was the motto of Lucerne Summer Festival 2011. Accordingly, the Berliner Philharmoniker under Sir Simon Rattle explored in their Lucerne series "Moving to Modern Times" the phenomenon of the night by pairing up in an outstanding concert the late romantic Anton Bruckner with England's greatest modern composer, Benjamin Britten. While Bruckner's Ninth Symphony involves an inner journey, Britten's "Nocturne" extends into a trance-like meditation on dreaming, the latter presented by acclaimed tenor Ian Bostridge, whose "particular gift for lighting texts from within, and projecting so immediately their images, comes into its own arrestingly in the Nocturne" stated the "Gramophone Magazine".

programme.title: Mendelssohn Piano Concerto No. 1 with Sir András Schiff
programme.desc: This spellbinding performance by Sir András Schiff breathes new life into Mendelssohn's concerto, transforming it into a living masterpiece. Schiff's interpretation fosters an intimate dialogue between musician and composer, highlighted by lively violin exchanges and a clarinet solo that steals the show. The dynamic interplay between horns and timpani captivates the London audience. Notable for its revolutionary continuous form, the piece was groundbreaking in the Romantic era, pushing the technical boundaries of the pianist. Experience a fresh perspective on this beloved concerto, now a revelatory journey through one of the 19th century's most compelling musical voices. Sir András Schiff shines as both soloist and conductor, leading the Orchestra of the Age of Enlightenment in this unmissable Mendelssohn performance.

programme.title: Sir András Schiff Performs Mendelssohn Piano Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: Experience Mendelssohn's masterpiece as it was meant to be heard. Sir András Schiff and the Orchestra of the Age of Enlightenment unite historical authenticity with extraordinary artistry at London's Queen Elizabeth Hall. Schiff performs on a rare 1859 Blüthner fortepiano, revealing the fiery brilliance and lyrical beauty of "Piano Concerto No. 2 in D Minor, Op. 40", all while seamlessly conducting from the keyboard. This concerto's unconventional three-movement structure was revolutionary for its time, setting a bold new standard for expressive piano composition. Renowned for their meticulous research and artistry, the OAE and Schiff bring Mendelssohn's genius to life, blending the Romantic era's passion with the precision of period instruments. Filmed live in April 2024 as part of the OAE's ''Mendelssohn: The Complete Symphonies series.'.

programme.title: Death and the King's Horseman
programme.desc: The Greater The Honour, The Deeper The Shame In British-occupied Nigeria, a Yoruba king, the Alafin, has died, and it is the duty of his horseman, Elesin, to accompany him into the afterlife. While lustily enjoying the pleasures of this world, Elesin proudly anticipates his transition to the next - but the sacred ritual is interrupted, resulting in unforeseen tragedy. Inspired by a real-life incident, this masterpiece from Nobel Prize winner Soyinka celebrates a community striving to uphold its culture in the face of colonial power.

programme.title: Rigoletto by Giuseppe Verdi
programme.desc: When a sharp-tongued court jester Rigoletto is cursed for his spiteful words, he is forced to hide his unworldly daughter Gilda from his own licentious master the Duke. For Verdi's wonderful ambivalent hunchback, paradise is the peaceful home and family that he struggles to protect. To showcase this scenario of drama, passion, deceit and revenge, which has been performed more than 300 times at the Teatro Real, the director will use the courtship and abduction of Gilda, the protagonist's daughter, to highlight the powerlessness of a woman in the face of a group of men in which the notion of masculinity in society is discussed. With the great voices of Javier Camarena, Xabier Anduaga, Ludovic Tézier, Adela Zaharia and Julie Fuchs.

programme.title: Nabucco
programme.desc: Daniele Abbado explores themes of identity, exile and religion in this powerful staging of Verdi's epic opera with Plácido Domingo as Nabucco.

programme.title: El Amor Brujo
programme.desc: A revision of the piece that Víctor Ullate premiered on May 28, 1994 at the Maestranza in Seville. For this new occasion, scenery and costumes are new, seeking to give greater prominence to the light -the fatuous fire-, present throughout the plot. In this version a groundbreaking musical bet is carried out with the inclusion of the dark ambience group "In Slaughter Natives", which adds to the musical effects created by Luis Delgado for the original version and that lead the viewer to a journey between life and death, a journey to the afterlife. The work, written by Falla in the early twentieth century and with a markedly Andalusian character, delves into gypsy mysticism, approaching love in its most primitive and essential form. It tells the story of Candela, a gypsy girl, whose love for Carmelo is haunted by the specter of her former lover. A story of love and passion, of tears and grief, of witchcraft and seduction, of death and dance. The choreography contains moments of great beauty, such as "Canción del amor dolido", "Romance del pescador" or "Canción del fuego fatuo". It should be noted that this version includes three popular songs written by Manuel de Falla: "Nana", "Polo" and "Asturiana", as well as a variation by Paco de Lucía for "José el eterno amante." A new version of El Amor Brujo, different in its forms, but eternal in its essence.

programme.title: Sutra
programme.desc: Choreographer Sidi Larbi Cherkaoui teamed up with Turner Prize winning artist Antony Gormley to create a new work inspired by the skill, strength, and spirituality of Buddhist Shaolin monks. This piece is nothing short of breathtaking. By visiting the Shaolin Temple, and working with the Shaolin Monks over several months, Sidi Larbi followed a lifelong interest of exploring the philosophy and faith behind the Shaolin tradition, its relationship with KungFu, and its position within a contemporary context. Sutra follows soloist Ali Thabet and 17 Monks performing a mixture of martial arts and contemporary dance on Gormley's moving set of 21 wooden boxes. Polish composer Szymon Brzóska's original score for piano, percussion and strings is played live as the movement flies across the stage. Watch as the Monks seemingly defy gravity in this captivating story of appreciation and acceptance.

programme.title: Love's Labour's Lost
programme.desc: A king and three friends swear off women to devote themselves to their studies just as a princess and three ladies arrive on a diplomatic mission. Shakespeare delivers a touching and funny coming-of-age story with a twist ending, beautifully told in this "vibrant" and "sublime" Stratford Festival production.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Theater. Inspired by the prophecies of three witches and encouraged by his ambitious wife, a murderous king claws his way to power. The Stratford Festival's chilling production of Macbeth will haunt your dreams and leave you tingling.

programme.title: Mendelssohn Piano Concerto No. 1 with Sir András Schiff
programme.desc: This spellbinding performance by Sir András Schiff breathes new life into Mendelssohn's concerto, transforming it into a living masterpiece. Schiff's interpretation fosters an intimate dialogue between musician and composer, highlighted by lively violin exchanges and a clarinet solo that steals the show. The dynamic interplay between horns and timpani captivates the London audience. Notable for its revolutionary continuous form, the piece was groundbreaking in the Romantic era, pushing the technical boundaries of the pianist. Experience a fresh perspective on this beloved concerto, now a revelatory journey through one of the 19th century's most compelling musical voices. Sir András Schiff shines as both soloist and conductor, leading the Orchestra of the Age of Enlightenment in this unmissable Mendelssohn performance.

programme.title: Sir András Schiff Performs Mendelssohn Piano Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: Experience Mendelssohn's masterpiece as it was meant to be heard. Sir András Schiff and the Orchestra of the Age of Enlightenment unite historical authenticity with extraordinary artistry at London's Queen Elizabeth Hall. Schiff performs on a rare 1859 Blüthner fortepiano, revealing the fiery brilliance and lyrical beauty of "Piano Concerto No. 2 in D Minor, Op. 40", all while seamlessly conducting from the keyboard. This concerto's unconventional three-movement structure was revolutionary for its time, setting a bold new standard for expressive piano composition. Renowned for their meticulous research and artistry, the OAE and Schiff bring Mendelssohn's genius to life, blending the Romantic era's passion with the precision of period instruments. Filmed live in April 2024 as part of the OAE's ''Mendelssohn: The Complete Symphonies series.'.

programme.title: Instinct
programme.desc: Three fighters, one vital resource, no room for compromise. "Instinct" is a tense, physically charged short dance film built around a single life-or-death struggle. As the dancers clash over water, their movement becomes a test of endurance, urgency, and survival. Their movements are sharp, stripped-back, and unflinching. Bodies strain, collide, and resist, mirroring the brutal realities of scarcity and entitlement. Every action carries consequences, and every choice exposes what desperation can bring in each of us. With a stark visual language and urgent momentum, this is a gripping meditation on survival, power, and the cost of getting what we need.

Every gesture and sequence is an unmissable balance of humor and drama. A cinematic delight, "Una Notte a Napoli" celebrates the joy, impermanence, and playful strangeness of everyday life.

programme.title: Maverick: The Story of the King's Head
programme.desc: Dan Crawford emigrated from Hackensack New Jersey to England in 1969. He walked into The King's Head, which hadn't been decorated since the 1930s and was very rundown and entirely deserted. But it had a back room (used for cock fighting in the 17th century and illegally for prize fighting in the 20th). A perfect space for a theatre. And so, with a small loan from his Mother, Edna, he applied to buy the lease. The brewery said "Well, nobody else wants it - may as well give it to you on a punt". Within a few months, the King's Head Theatre was born! It was 1970; The King's Head was the first pub theatre in England since pre-Shakespearean times. The first play - an absurdist comedy - didn't do very well. But the second: John Fowle's The Collector, was a hit! The King's Head went on to enjoy many successes - championing a richly eclectic programme of new writing, musicals and classic revivals, and launching the careers of dozens of household names. The constant stream of work that the King's Head produced provided essential fodder for the West End - with on average one show transferring every year.

programme.title: Stepping into the Unknown
programme.desc: Christian Spuck brought one of Verdi's key works to the stage with Messa da Requiem. In a mega co-production by the Opera and Ballet Zürich, the German choreographer and director portrays a profound interpretation of Verdi's funeral mass in his scenic-choreographic production.

programme.title: Nabucco
programme.desc: Daniele Abbado explores themes of identity, exile and religion in this powerful staging of Verdi's epic opera with Plácido Domingo as Nabucco.

programme.title: ORA Singers Celebrates the Queen's Platinum Jubilee
programme.desc: Founded in 2016 by Suzi Digby, ORA Singers is now one of the most active vocal ensembles in England. In the great tradition of choirs from across the Channel, the English conductor has concocted a program in tribute to the 70 years of Elizabeth II's reign. Drawing from the most beautiful collections of a cappella pieces of the English Renaissance (Tallis, Byrd, Gibbons, etc.) intermingled with works commissioned by the ensemble, Suzi Digby maliciously draws a musical link between the two most famous Elizabeth's of England.

programme.title: Tempest
programme.desc: "Tempest," starring Agnes Su of Stuttgart Ballet, is a mesmerizing dance film that captures the delicate tension between aspiration and self-acceptance. With stark simplicity and emotional honesty, Su's performance embodies the beauty and struggle of striving for perfection, revealing the quiet moments where vulnerability and grace meet. Elegant, intimate, and very moving, "Tempest" is a celebration of the artistry in imperfection and the courage it takes to dance on your own terms.

programme.title: Sofiane Pamart: Piano Day
programme.desc: Sofiane Pamart is a piano virtuoso. He was only 4 years old when he started playing the piano. A child prodigy with an ultra-competitive soul, he proclaims himself "Piano King" and clearly defines his ambitions: to be the world's number one piano player. First step in this planetary conquest: Sofiane Pamart has already seduced the world of French rap. In his official bio, the artist defines himself as "a high fashion pianist with the mentality and image of a rapper". If this attitude, associated with a fiery temperament, is impressive, the young rebel of French neoclassical music has nevertheless managed to conquer a large audience, thanks to the emotional accuracy of his work. At once poetic and dark, romantic and obscure, the melodies he composes speak to all hearts.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 31, Op. 110

In following in the footsteps of such masters as Artur Schnabel, Barenboim truly shows himself to be among the greatest living musicians.

programme.title: Richard III
programme.desc: His succession plan will slay you. Charismatic, cunning and utterly ruthless, Richard, Duke of Gloucester (Colm Feore) is the very embodiment of lethal ambition as he maneuvers and murders his way to the throne of England. But once he reaches the top, the only way is down and in Richard's growing roster of vengeful enemies, none are more menacing than the ghosts of his past.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Theater. Inspired by the prophecies of three witches and encouraged by his ambitious wife, a murderous king claws his way to power. The Stratford Festival's chilling production of Macbeth will haunt your dreams and leave you tingling.

programme.title: Golden Stage
programme.desc: The Golden Stage brings together the crème de la crème of avant-garde hip-hop dancers. The Golden Stage plateau International hip-hop brings together the cream of the avant-garde hip-hop scene at the Grande Halle de la Villette. It's a hard-hitting evening of four short shows (twenty minutes each, with stand-up Nick Mukoko as master of ceremonies this year), highlighting hip-hop dance in all its virtuosity, audacity and, above all, diversity, by programming more underground trends that are not usually represented on institutional stages.

programme.title: Rigoletto by Giuseppe Verdi
programme.desc: When a sharp-tongued court jester Rigoletto is cursed for his spiteful words, he is forced to hide his unworldly daughter Gilda from his own licentious master the Duke. For Verdi's wonderful ambivalent hunchback, paradise is the peaceful home and family that he struggles to protect. To showcase this scenario of drama, passion, deceit and revenge, which has been performed more than 300 times at the Teatro Real, the director will use the courtship and abduction of Gilda, the protagonist's daughter, to highlight the powerlessness of a woman in the face of a group of men in which the notion of masculinity in society is discussed. With the great voices of Javier Camarena, Xabier Anduaga, Ludovic Tézier, Adela Zaharia and Julie Fuchs.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons: A Ballet By David Nixon Era CBE
programme.desc: In 18th century France, letters fly between the mansions of two bored aristocrats as they spin a web of heartbreak and ruin. It might seem like a game, but lives will be ruined and love irrevocably lost. From the original scandalous novel, the acclaimed film starring John Malkovich and Michelle Pfeiffer and iconic retelling Cruel Intentions, this dangerous story has been thrilling audiences for over 200 years. Northern Ballet's bodice-ripping adaptation is set to Vivaldi's The Four Seasons, played live by Northern Ballet Sinfonia. You'll feel every heartbeat of this intimate performance.

programme.title: Mahler 3 - Paavo Järvi - Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.desc: In its 20th season, the Lucerne Festival Orchestra opens the 2023 Summer Festival with Mahler's Third. Unfortunately, music director Riccardo Chailly cannot conduct this momentous concert due to health issues. Paavo Järvi takes over on short notice and proves to be a more than worthy substitute. In Mahler's Third, he leads orchestra, chorus, and soloist Wiebke Lehmkuhl to an "air-spirited serenity" (Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung), that is met with enthusiastic applause. To this day, Mahler's Third is considered one of the most magnificent and powerful achievements bridging late Romanticism and modernism, ranging from simple folksong-like melodies to the coarse sounds of a marching brass band. The long-standing Mahler experience of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra shines through at every moment. Paired with Wiebke Lehmkuhl's warm and comforting timbre, the clarity of the two choirs and the expert guidance by Paavo Järvi, this opening concert turns into a veritable moment of glory.

programme.title: Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: The much sought-after stage director and performer Olivier Py, who has put on more than forty works of opera around the world, will be tackling Madama Butterfly for the first time, placing the orchestra up on stage inside the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, and filling the Roman outdoor venue with the aesthetics and colours of Japan, as filtered through his own signature directorial style. Working with him to create the sets and costumes is his long-time collaborator Pierre-André Weitz. Giacomo Puccini's "Japanese tragedy", first presented at La Scala in Milan in 1904, tells the story of the star-crossed love harboured by the fifteen-year-old geisha Cio-Cio-San for Benjamin Franklin Pinkerton, a lieutenant in the United States Navy. An American officer acquired the services of the young geisha Miss Butterfly at an expense of 39 dollars per month. Four dollars of this bought the license that entitled her to be his mistress, and to a daily bath in the public bathhouse. He paid her 25 dollars a month and hired a room and a servant for her, which cost another ten dollars. For this sum, he enjoyed all the comforts of a married man for a set time, and she had a roof over her head and a servant at her command. On leaving for America, he promised he would return to her when the robins nest again but in fact deserted her, leaving her desperately poor, with babe in arms. The author John Luther Long was inspired by this account of a real-life young geisha called Cio-Cio-San -recounted to him by his sister, who had lived in Nagasaki- to start writing his own short story of the tale, which formed the basis for a theatre play and, subsequently, Puccini's opera.

programme.title: Prayers
programme.desc: "Prayers" is a bold, kinetic dance film directed and choreographed by Or Schraiber, where movement becomes a vessel for spiritual longing and emotional release. Set against the arid urban backdrop of the L.A River, dancers navigate gritty streets and graffitied architecture, their bodies trace the tension between struggle, connection, and hope. Infused with global rhythms and rich musical textures, the choreography transforms everyday spaces into a stage for human yearning. This short dance video defies traditional boundaries, merging contemporary dance, immersive music, and cinematic visuals to create a shared emotional experience. Prayers is a captivating meditation on movement, sound, and the universal search for meaning in turbulent times.

programme.title: Rumpelstiltskin
programme.desc: Newcastle-based balletLORENT filmed Rumpelstiltskin at Northern Stage, Newcastle, in October 2017, before touring the UK to much acclaim and success. Liv Lorent, Director and Choreographer balletLORENT, said: "Rumpelstiltskin is the story of the outsider, shunned for being different, and the secret power and knowledge he possesses. He is the original super mutant, a fairytale X-Man in a story of love, obsession, childhood, grief and reconciliation that is made as much for children as it is for adults.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons: A Ballet By David Nixon Era CBE
programme.desc: In 18th century France, letters fly between the mansions of two bored aristocrats as they spin a web of heartbreak and ruin. It might seem like a game, but lives will be ruined and love irrevocably lost. From the original scandalous novel, the acclaimed film starring John Malkovich and Michelle Pfeiffer and iconic retelling Cruel Intentions, this dangerous story has been thrilling audiences for over 200 years. Northern Ballet's bodice-ripping adaptation is set to Vivaldi's The Four Seasons, played live by Northern Ballet Sinfonia. You'll feel every heartbeat of this intimate performance.

programme.title: Benjamin Grosvenor Plays Mozart
programme.desc: Two contrasting masterpieces take center stage in this brilliant concert from the London Philharmonic Orchestra conducted by Andrey Boreyko. Acclaimed British pianist Benjamin Grosvenor brings what Seen and Heard International described as an "understated lightness of touch" to Mozart's Piano Concerto No.21. This beloved work is the epitome of regal elegance, especially in the slow movement, which Grosvenor shapes with the radiance and fluidity of a "waterfall sparking in sunshine." Written during a period of extreme personal turmoil, Tchaikovsky's Symphony No.4 is an exploration of the inescapable force of fate. It opens wth a powerful brass fanfare, representing fate, which is echoed throughout the piece. As the composer explained in a letter, this musical "kernel" is "the fatal power which prevents one from attaining the goal of happiness ... There is nothing to be done but to submit to it." From brooding introspection to unbounded joy, the work charts an emotional journey of struggle and triumph. Together, Boreyko, Grosvenor, and the LPO give an unforgettable concert that will stay with you long after the final note. Program: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 21, K467 * Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 *Benjamin Grosvenor, Piano Please note: Benjamin Grosvenor's performance of Mozart's Piano Concerto will be available to stream on Marquee TV until 25 August 2025, 7.00 pm (GMT). This performance will then appear as "Sibelius & Tchaikovsky." Additional note about credit: Benjamin Grosvenor appears courtesy of Decca Records.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Berliner Philharmoniker - Britten / Bruckner 9
programme.desc: "Night" was the motto of Lucerne Summer Festival 2011. Accordingly, the Berliner Philharmoniker under Sir Simon Rattle explored in their Lucerne series "Moving to Modern Times" the phenomenon of the night by pairing up in an outstanding concert the late romantic Anton Bruckner with England's greatest modern composer, Benjamin Britten. While Bruckner's Ninth Symphony involves an inner journey, Britten's "Nocturne" extends into a trance-like meditation on dreaming, the latter presented by acclaimed tenor Ian Bostridge, whose "particular gift for lighting texts from within, and projecting so immediately their images, comes into its own arrestingly in the Nocturne" stated the "Gramophone Magazine".

programme.title: Rhoda Scott & The Ladies All Star
programme.desc: The American organist Rhoda Scott, surrounds herself here with the rising generation of jazz women in France and offers us a real bacchanal of the groove. A will in the continuity of a career which never stopped affirming the place of women in jazz, a movement of which she was one of the pioneers. With her passion intact, Rhoda Scott, "The Barefoot Lady", brings together the confirmed soloists of the Lady Quartet and the new generation of jazz women. These All Stars Ladies with their spirited groove, acclaimed by the entire Jazz planet, are guided by an exceptional and generous artist, a true fairy of the Hammond organ with an immediately recognizable sound.

programme.title: Chick Corea, Piano Solo
programme.desc: Watch legendary jazz pianist Chick Corea show off his improvisation skills in this 1982 concert. Considered one of the most accomplished jazz pianists, Chick Corea's 6-decade career has left a lasting influence on the world of jazz. He won 27 Grammy's for his compositions and arrangements and is credited with significantly influencing the worlds of free jazz, bebop, straight-ahead jazz, Latin jazz, and jazz fusion. In this live recording, Chick Corea performs four improvised variations of Thelonious Monk's ''Round Midnight'. Just Chick and his Steinway.

programme.title: Death and the King's Horseman
programme.desc: The Greater The Honour, The Deeper The Shame In British-occupied Nigeria, a Yoruba king, the Alafin, has died, and it is the duty of his horseman, Elesin, to accompany him into the afterlife. While lustily enjoying the pleasures of this world, Elesin proudly anticipates his transition to the next - but the sacred ritual is interrupted, resulting in unforeseen tragedy. Inspired by a real-life incident, this masterpiece from Nobel Prize winner Soyinka celebrates a community striving to uphold its culture in the face of colonial power.

programme.title: The Velveteen Rabbit
programme.desc: balletLORENT's adaptation delves into the universal themes of childhood innocence and the passage of time, beautifully illustrating how love and companionship shape identity and offering a heartfelt reminder of the power of connection. The story resonates with audiences of all ages, evoking memories of cherished childhood toys and the emotions attached to them. Adults will find themselves reflecting on the fleeting nature of time, while younger audiences will be enthralled by the magic of toys coming to life. At its core, The Velveteen Rabbit is a tale of hope, resilience, and the enduring power of love. balletLORENT's production captures this essence with breathtaking dance, evocative storytelling, and stunning visuals, ensuring the story's timeless message remains as powerful as ever. This emotionally moving performance is a true celebration of imagination, love, and the magic of believing—leaving audiences with a sense of wonder that lingers long after the final curtain falls.

programme.title: Una Notte a Napoli
programme.desc: Set to music by Pink Martini, "Una Notte a Napoli" ( A Night in Napoli) is a playful and cinematic dance film that is delightfully whimsical, romantic, and just a little bit strange. Directed and choreographed by Lucia Lopez Sanchez, the film flows with a teasing charm, leading us through a story that hints of mystery, mischief, and fleeting joys without ever fully revealing its secrets. Every gesture and sequence is an unmissable balance of humor and drama. A cinematic delight, "Una Notte a Napoli" celebrates the joy, impermanence, and playful strangeness of everyday life.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 1, Op. 2.1
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. Daniel Barenboim is one such pianist - his recordings run the gamut from Bach and Mozart to Bruckner and Bartók. In following in the footsteps of such masters as Artur Schnabel, Barenboim truly shows himself to be among the greatest living musicians.

programme.title: The Land of Smiles
programme.desc: "Always smile and always be cheerful, always satisfied, no matter what happens, smile in spite of your sorrows and a thousand aches and pains," sings Prince Sou-Chong, thus introducing the fundamentally melancholy tone of this operetta, which even has a tragic ending in store. Franz Lehár's operetta Das Land des Lächelns ("The Land of Smiles") is one of the best-known hits of all time - and, according to Kurt Tucholsky, is the "the Puccini for the common man." Like Puccini's Madame Butterfly, Lehar focuses on Asian subjects, thematizing the European attraction for the exotic in the encounter of two people whose love is shattered by foreign customs and ancient traditions. For the production of this operetta Piotr Beczala, a world star who cultivates the tradition of the famous Tauber style like no other, was returning to the Opernhaus Zürich as Sou-Chong. He has an equal partner in Julia Kleiter, who plays the role of Lisa. Fabio Luisi and Andreas Homoki also know that the genre of operetta requires particular care - which is why they have assumed personal responsibility for this production.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. "Sestre" je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.title: Džeronimo Stilton
programme.desc: Ime mu je Stilton, Džeronimo Stilton. Pisac u zemlji glodara, koji piše najbolje priče! Očaravajući, neverovatan glavni urednik koji je i veliki avantrurista! U tri reči: humor, avantura i ...humor! Doživljaji malog, pametnog miša, Džeronima Stiltona su puni uzbuđenja, akcije i sve to začinjeno sa malo humora. Naravno, to ne znači da se naši junaci ne upetljavaju u razne opasne situacije iz kojih se ipak uvek uspešno izvlače i izlaze kao pobednici. Džeronimovi drugari i članovi porodice pomažu mu da savlada prepreke i da uspešno istražuje i zajedno su za sve sposobni. Ponekad, ipak dolazi do nesuglasica i to prouzrokuje smešne situacije, ali se na kraju svi pomire, jer se bezuslovno.

programme.desc: Jedne noći, pudlicu sa takmičenja lepote napalo je u njenoj kući stvorenje sa pipcima.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Devojke Veverice planiraju da dokažu Alvinu i dečacima da superheroji nisu samo dečaci i muškarci.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Gđica Smit kaže Alvinu da, ako ne položi sledeći test, ponavljaće razred i biće razdvojen od svoje braće.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Majmun kapuciner Sapažu je tajanstveno nestao dok se igrao sa svojim mladim vlasnikom Ralfom. Da li je otet? Da li je namerno pobegao? I ako jeste, zašto? Izgleda da se Ralf dobro odnosi prema Sapažuu, snima ga dok izvodi cirkuske tačke i postavlja snimke na internet. Nakon razgovora sa ljudima iz komšiluka, naši istraživači saznaju da je Sapadžu više puta napadao ljude i uzimao im kravate, bicikle, kišobrane... U stvari sve predmete koje je koristio u snimcima! Šta ako majmun nije imao snage da radi ono što je Ralf želeo.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Ludovi mama i tata dele starateljstvo nad njim, što znači da je on jedne nedelje kod svog tate, a druge kod svoje mame. Da bi izbegli sukobe, roditelji su mu kupili sve dvostruko: stvari za školu, računare i konzole za igru, pa čak i dva pacova. A kad jedan od njih nestane, Pets klub hitno stupa na scenu! Ubrzo otkrivaju da su pacovi bili par i da ih je Ludov otac razdvojio. Pa ako je jedan pacov nestao, to je zato što želi da nađe svog partnera (neke vrste pacova su veoma vezane za svog partnera).

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.desc: Snoubol i Čarkoil, Kleverine komšije iz prodavnice kućnih ljubimaca, oteli su tokom noći. Klever dobija tablet koji ih prikazuje kao zarobljenike. Prepoznaje mesto gde su zatočeni: sobu sa blagom templara.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Kuconja shvata da nije trebalo da se ponese loše prema drugarima i čini sve što može da ih nađe i spreči Lošiku da uđe u Štab branilaca. Lošika dolazi do svih Simketovih uređaja koje mu je Poli oduzela i namerava da ih upotrebi protiv Kuconje.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Lošika krade deo Kuconjinog prstena. Ispostavlja se da je to polijum, materijal koji je Poli otkrila, a koji ima izuzetna svojstva. Nakon što je primorala Poli da joj obezbedi još polijuma, Lošika teroriše grad svojim novim moćima i šalje branioce, jednog po jednog, kroz višedimenzionalne prolaze. Protiv te nove pretnje, samo Kuconja, sa svojim nestabilnim moćima, i Robo-kuca, sa svojim kvarovima, možda mogu da spasu situaciju.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Žice na Maestrovom teniskom reketu su pukle. On odlazi da nađe drugi, vodeći nas u srednjovekovnu opatiju, gde monasi igraju ""Igru dlanova"", udarajuću lopticu rukama. Uskoro će gole ruke zameniti rukavice, zatim palica, i na kraju reket! Igra je doživela ogroman uspeh, čak i među francuskim kraljevima.

Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina se ponaša kao prava napast i teroriše Vendi i Sami koje pokušavaju da gledaju svoj omiljeni film strave! Kad roditelji nađu DVD sa filmom strave, odlučuju da na prevaru odvrate sestre od gledanja filma, da bi mogli da ga na miru gledaju sami.

programme.title: Barbi - Zlatokosa
programme.desc: "Zlatokosa" je klasična priča o devojci sa dugom, lepršavom kosom, koja je zarobljena u kuli, s tim što ova priča ima novi zaplet. Dugokosa je snažan uzor koji odbija da prihvati ulogu zatočenika i sluge moćne veštice. Ona na kraju ne samo da uspeva da promeni tok sopstvenog života, već i svojom hrabrošću uspeva da se izbori za mir u dva zaraćena kraljevstva. Dugokosi u njenoj potrazi za istinom i slobodom pomažu njena dva najbolja prijatelja: Penelopa, mladi ljubičasti zmaj koji pokušava da ispuni očekivanja svog oca o tome kakav treba da bude jedan moćni zmaj i koji otkriva da postoji više načina da neko bude "moćan", i Hobi, mrzovoljni stari zeka koji bi najviše voleo kada se ništa u životu ne bi meljalo.

programme.title: Barbi: Avanture u kući iz snova
programme.desc: Upoznaj Barbi i njene najbolje drugare - zajedno sa prvim komšijom Kenom - u ovom animiranom vlogu avantura snimljenom u njenoj porodičnoj kući snova.

programme.title: Lego prijatelji: Sledeće poglavlje
programme.desc: Alija, Otem, Lijen i Nova organizuju prespavanjac u Oteminoj štali. Leo i Zak su oduševljeni Novinim dronom, te će i oni doći na prespavanjac kako bi saznali više o njemu. Strašna priča, nestanak hrane, munje, gromovi, jezivi zvukovi i sablasne senke navode družinu da posumnjaju na duhove.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Vendi je dozlogrdilo da joj Marina krade dnevnik. Maksans joj daje sjajnu ideju: šta kad bi mala napast imala sopstveni dnevnik? Vendi daje Marini njen prvi dnevnik... Mala napast je oduševljena, ali ubrzo se zapita šta bi mogla da napiše u njega... Tajne o svojoj starijoj sestri, naravno.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina želi da se penje na drvo sa svojom voljenom sestrom, ali Vendi se jedva budi u podne i stalno zeva izležavajući se na kauču! Šta je to sa njom? Lulu i Nata joj objašnjavaju da je njena sestra u lenjoj fazi. To je odlika tinejdžera. Stalno su umorni.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Dečaci i devojčice se takmiče da postave svetski rekord da bi osvojili novu igricu u virtelnoj stvarnosti.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kad Alvin nagovori Dejva da kupi polovni bus za turneje, Dejv nema pojma kakvi ga sve problemi čekaju.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin prijavi veverice za kviz u kom gubitnici moraju da izvode opasne poduhvate.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Kris i Martin se raspakuju nakon avanture i iznenađuju se kad mladunče vuka izađe iz njihove torbe. Nemaju pojma odakle taj mališa dolazi i moraju da se sete čitavog puta da bi ga vratili njegovom čoporu. Shvataju da su vukovi veoma društvene životinje sa snažnom strukturom čopora i čestom komunikacijom među članovima. Sa ovim znanjem i odelima sa moćima vuka, braća uspevaju da oteraju gladnu pumu i konačno vrate mladunče njegovom čoporu.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Danas je Avivin rođendan i Kris i Martin odlučuju da skupe odbačene bodlje bodljikavog praseta da bi joj napravili lepu ogrlicu kao poklon. Dok prate afričko bodljikavo prase, otkrivaju da životinje imaju različite načine, nekad i vrlo posebne osobine, kojima se brane od grabljivaca. Na primer, bodlje bodljikavog praseta su izmenjene dlake koje je priroda dizajnirala kao smrtonosnu odbranu. Braća Kret moraju da koriste ovu zadivljujuću odbranu da bi zaštitili bodljikave prasiće od Zakovog najnovijeg plana za hvatanje životinja.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestro započinje dugotrajno hedonističko putovanje sa Majama, koje uživaju u piću od kakao zrna koje nazivaju čokolatl. Dalje otkriva kako je s vremenom izmišljen predmet koji čokoladu, jednu od omiljenih svetskih poslastica, pretvara u proizvod koji je lako otpremiti i skladištiti. Ipak, tokom svoje svetske avanture, Maestro će imati problem da zagrize samo jedan zalogaj.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestro započinje dugotrajno hedonističko putovanje sa Majama, koje uživaju u piću od kakao zrna koje nazivaju čokolatl. Dalje otkriva kako je s vremenom izmišljen predmet koji čokoladu, jednu od omiljenih svetskih poslastica, pretvara u proizvod koji je lako otpremiti i skladištiti. Ipak, tokom svoje svetske avanture, Maestro će imati problem da zagrize samo jedan zalogaj.

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Štaaaaaaa? Majmun nevaljalac? Ali nemojte odmah da pomišljate na najgore! Džordž, pored toga što sjajno zabavlja sve članove svoje porodice, ima i mnogo korisnih informacija o prirodnim naukama na poljima matematike, ali ako dobro paziš, saznaćeš ponešto i iz tehnike. Uz pomoć Džordžove neuništive radoznalosti, na kraju serije i ti ćeš da postaneš mali naučnik, a dlakavi prijatelj ti takođe garantuje i dobro raspoloženje. Ostani sa nama!Štaaaaaaa? programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Stigli su praznici, a napušteni haski već dva dana laje u dvorištu. Uzbunjeni, drugari iz Pets kluba otkrivaju nekoliko napuštenih životinja u komšiluku i spasavaju ih. Zašto je toliko pasa i mačaka ostavljeno bez hrane i pića? Trag ih vodi do određenog Marsela koji treba da vodi računa o tim životinjama dok su vlasnici na odmoru. Da li je on prevarant? Odgovor će se veoma razlikovati od onoga što su drugari iz Pets kluba očekivali i moraće da zaborave na svoj odmor da bi se pobrinuli za životinje.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Kristinina kornjača nestala je iz ograđenog prostora... Kao da je isparila! Članovi Pets kluba takmiče se u rešavanju ovog slučaja. Uprkos dokazima, istraga nikako ne napreduje: pseće dlake su nađene u kavezu, ali Kristinin pas ne bi mogao da preskoči ogradu. Vrana je nedužna, uprkos perju koje je svuda po bašti. Čak je i mladi mađioničar osumnjičen ni zbog čega. Pets klub je u ćorsokaku... Ali kornjača možda nikad nije ni napustila ograđeni prostor.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Mada obično ne brine o divljim životinjama, Pets klub pomaže Nuru da izleči povređenog ježa kog je našao u svojoj bašti... Pošto životinja slabi, odnose ga kod Žilua, njihovog druga veterinara, koji im saopštava neverovatne vesti: ovaj jež je u stvari... Ženka koja je upravo dobila bebe. Počinje trka protiv vremena i potraga za bebama koje će biti gladne bez svoje mame... Drugari brzo shvataju da je ježa povredio bicikl u parku..

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Mladi frizer za pse poziva Pets klub da pronađe psa rase njufaundlend, koji je pobegao posle plivanja. Trideset kila mišića sa mnogo tamnog krzna ne može da prođe neopaženo, a ipak, istraga je bila teška. Vlasnica psa je glavom i bradom gospođica Kornil, njihova učiteljica, pa je izazov još hitniji. Prateći tragove, oni otkrivaju da je pas koga privlači voda otišao da pliva u jezercetu. Iscrpeo se i ne može da izađe iz vode, pa je sada u opasnosti od davljenja... Pets klub mora da nađe brzo rešenje.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Garfild je lenji, sebični, gojazni narandžasti mačak čiji omiljeni hobiji su: izležavanje, spavanje, gledanje televizije, proždiranje pice i zabavljanje... Ali on ima veliko srce i, mada prvo obično pokaže svoju sebičnu stranu, zahvaljujući svojoj genijalnosti, uspeva da spasi stvar, pa čak i da izbavi Odija iz nevolje.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Pridružite ce avanturama Krisa i Martina Kreta dok se susreću sa neverovatnim divljim životinjama, kombinujući naučno obrazovanje sa zabavom i avanturom, putujući do životinjskih staništa širom sveta. Svaka avantura istražuje život životinja i prikazuje do sada neviđen aspekt života u divljini. To je sve upakovano u zanimljivu priču o avanturi, misteriji, spasavanju i veoma zanimljivu komediju braće Kret od kakve ćete se grohotom smejati.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Mali Šef voli nagrade, a trofej Zlatna Zvečka nije izuzetak. Kada dobije priliku da osvoji nagradni odmor u kompanijskom odmaralištu, moraće da bira između svog posla i svog tima. Tim se prepušta uslugama u odmaralištu i vraća se u bebeće stanje.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Mali Šef pravi organizacioni grafikon kojim će potvrditi svoj položaj šefa beba iz grupe za igranje. Međutim, kada fotograf Babizija Trevis Le Duk odbije da ga izabere za svoju naslovnicu, njegov položaj postaje ugrožen! Tim nikako ne uspeva da uradi domaći zadatak: da napravi model Sunčevog sistema.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina je preterala i razbila Vendin telefon. Da bi izbegla njen gnev, pretvara se da je izgubila pamćenje. Vendi naseda i pokušava da pomogne sestri da povrati pamćenje podvrgavajući je terapijama elektrošokovima..

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina podražava Vendi kao da su bliznakinje. Iako je Vendi nekad mislila da je to slatko, sada je to jako nervira, naročito kada Marina želi da zauzme njeno mesto na bazenu. Svaki put je isto: Vendi i njene drugarice završe izbačene zbog Marininog izmotavanja. Ali ovog puta, Vendi odlučuje da je dosta.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne Ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. Ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. Sestre je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.title: Hotel za ljubimce
programme.desc: Predivna raspričana papagajka je naša današnja gošća. Ona može da imitira glasove i ponavlja sve što čuje. NeiNei, Bubu, Viki i Lili su zapanjeni njenom sposobnošću. Četiri životinje sa računara saznaju da je ova vrsta papagaja jedna od najpametnijih ptica i da može da priča kao čovek. Papagajka se igra sa svima u hotelu za ljubimce. Postaje veoma popularna, jer sve životinje smatraju da je baš zanimljiva. NeiNei joj daje zadatak: da leti unaokolo i sazna smešne stvari koje može da podeli sa njima.

programme.title: Hotel za ljubimce
programme.desc: Danas je dan za izlet. Robin vodi ljubimce u park, i u parku sreće svoju simpatiju Džasmin. Želi da izgleda opušteno pred njom. Postaje nervozan i govori ljubimcima da se klone nevolja. Dok je Robin odsutan, Lili, NeiNei i Viki se igraju frizbijem. Bubu je premali da bi se igrao. Pokušava da uhvati frizbi, ali frizbi ga odnosi i on pada na drvo. Hari, tata jastreb, živi na drvetu. Primećuje da Lili, NeiNei i Viki zadirkuju Bubua, pa ga nosi u svoje gnezdo visoko na drvetu i govori mu da se na neko vreme skloni od svojih drugara. Ostale tri životinje su u panici.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Mengov papagaj Alfi obično je vrlo pričljiv... Ali jednog jutra odjednom više ne govori! Zašto? To je zagonetka koju Pets klub mora da reši. Mengova starija sestra je najozbiljniji osumnjičeni. Da li je papagaj Alfi video nešto i hteo to da ponovi.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Jednog vrućeg dana Ameli shvata da je njena kuca Hermiona nestala. Pets klub sreće Amelinog komšiju Džeremija. Džeremi se ponaša toliko uvrnuto da Pets klub počinje da sumnja u njega... Ali saznajemo da je krivac zapravo Amelin brat Gabrijel, koji je bio dovoljno nesmotren da izvede psa u šetnju i ostavi ga na suncu. Pets klub saznaje da i psi mogu da dobiju bolne opekotine od sunca.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Mačkoslav pljačka banku. Poli daje Kuconji poseban sat. Pošto je trapav, Kuconja uspeva da se vrati samo par sekundi unazad. Kad Mačkoslav zgrabi sat, moći će da ga koristi da ukrade sve što želi i učini branioce nemoćnim.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Da bi ukrao čuveni dragulj u obliku mačke, Mačkoslavu treba mnogo brži saveznik. Poput... Av-Ava! U štabu branilaca, Av-Av saznaje da je Mačkoslav njegov rođak i želi da se zbliži sa njim. Poli i Kuconja ozbiljno sumnjaju u to i nameravaju da sprovedu istragu.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Detektiv Mekfler i njegova ekipa tolerišu poznatog odmetnika "Robina Huda," zagonetnog psa koji krade neprodatu hranu za ljude da bi je delio lutalicama iz balona. Sve dok im jednog dana ne pošalje poruku u kojoj preti kraljici.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Veverice prate Dejva i plaše se da se zaljubio u ženu koja od njega hoće da napravi voštanu figuru.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Da bi dobio posao u školskim novinama, Alvin pomaže Sajmonu da objavi najveću priču u školi.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Veverice imaju 48 sati da pomognu Džanet da snimi film. Ali svi imaju drugačiji film na pameti.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Džonov najbolji drug Lajman možda je Zabaduov talac u Franistanu! Džon i Garfild su upoznali Lajmana i Odija pre mnogo godina. Garfild je odmah pokušao da ubaci Odija u kantu za smeće... Onda je Lajman ostavio Odija kod Džona, otišao u Franistan da slika Zabadua i nikad se nije vratio! Ali danas na televiziji, izvesni pustolov Dirk Dinkam tvrdi da će pokušati da spasi Zabaduove taoce... Za novac, naravno! Džon je toliko usredsređen na dokumentarac da će otkriti svojim nećakinjama bliznakinjama gde se Garfild upravo sakrio od njih. Srećom, Garfild je spremio trikove kojim će ih poslati kod Odija.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Džon je upravo na televiziji video da Zabadu nosi šešir koji je on jednom poklonio Lajmanu, svom drugu fotografu. Sad mora dobro da razmisli, pa odlučuje da odveze bliznakinje kući. Fju! Garfild napokon može da gleda emisiju Edija Gurmana! Ali kasno uveče, Odi zavija na mesec, a Džon se prevrće u krevetu. Šta je sa borbom protiv Zabadua? Skvik ima savet za Garfilda. Garfild se u trenu pretvara u Indijanu Džonsa i odleće u sopstvenom avionu, zajedno sa Odijem i Skvikom. A tamo, naravno, pobeđuje Zabadua... Ali njegova maštarija je tako glasna da je Džon sada budan i spreman da krene u spasavanje Lajmana... A to je sasvim druga priča.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Užasan u igri žmurke, Tank moli Babu da ga nauči da se krije. Uz njenu obuku, ubrzo joj postaje partner u zločinu, i pomaže joj u pljačkama i prevarama.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Don mrzi kuglice od cvekle koje sprema njena majka i krišom ih baca u lagunu da je ne bi uvredila. Ali kada Betermanovi (i Ip) krenu u podvodnu ekspediciju u laguni, Don mora da laže, odvlači pažnju i sabotira, da porodica ne bi otkrila njenu tajnu.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Sve Vendine drugarice su uverene da Marinina omiljena igračka donosi sreću. Samo Vendi smatra da to nije istina, ali ono što se događa ne ide u prilog njenom mišljenju! I to toliko da sada svi žele da se dokopaju igračke koja donosi sreću..

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marinina noga završava u gipsu nakon što je pokušala da izigrava kaskaderku. Pošto je starija sestra sada neguje, Marina pokušava da iskoristi okolnosti i ponaša se prema njoj kao prema sluškinji... Do te mere da će Vendi izgubiti strpljenje! Sve dok i sama ne slomi nogu..

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina i Vendi provode dane igrajući video-igre na telefonu. Njihovi roditelji se klade da neće moći da izdrže jedan dan bez njih. To je siguran dobitak, jer su im svi ekrani sada oduzeti.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dok gleda naučno-fantastični film, Marina postaje uverena da je Maksans vanzemaljac prerušen u dečaka koji želi da otme njenu sestru i odvede je na planetu sa koje je došao! Ništa je neće sprečiti da spasi Vendi, čak ni ako na kraju bude morala da otme užasnog vanzemaljca, ne shvatajući da je u pitanju siroti Maksans prerušen u vanzemaljca..

programme.title: Zoro
programme.desc: Naša nova serija predstavlja tinejdžera Don Dijega, koji se suočava sa najvećim životnim izazovom boreći se za pravdu protiv brojnih bezobzirnih tirana! Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom "Z".

programme.title: Zoro
programme.desc: Naša nova serija predstavlja tinejdžera Don Dijega, koji se suočava sa najvećim životnim izazovom boreći se za pravdu protiv brojnih bezobzirnih tirana! Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom "Z".

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestro spava pod zvezdama, ali mu nedostaje udoban krevet. Vodi nas na putovanje na kom otkrivamo istoriju tog važnog komada nameštaja. Nije bilo uobičajeno da jedna osoba spava sama u malom krevetu. U srednjem veku ljudi su radije spavali zagrljeni u istom krevetu kako bi se zagrejali.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: U očajničkom pokušaju da se osvete za prošlogodišnji poraz, veverice se raspravljaju ko je najbolji da ih povede u pobedu.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvinu je dosta više da gleda kako je njegov status slavne ličnosti u senci zvezda iz rijalitija. Zato i on odlučuje da bude takva zvezda. Jedini problem je što mora da snimi Dejva bez njegovog znanja.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Eleanor je napravila tortu za takmičenje i ostavila je da se ohladi. Britani i Alvin dolaze kući i ne znaju koliko je ta torta važna, pa počinju da je jedu.Da li će napraviti novu na vreme? Ili će od Eleanorinih snova ostati samo mrvice.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Momci su zabrinuti da će Dejv preseliti celu porodicu u svoju kuću iz snova, pa odlučuju da naprave da izgleda da je kuća ukleta da je niko ne bi kupio.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: U nadi da će zadiviti svog modnog idola, Britani počinje da se bavi slikanjem. Ali njenom idolu se sviđa slika koju je Alvin slučajno upropastio. Britani to ne zna, pa počinje da misli da je umetnica koja je spremna za veliku izložbu.

Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.title: Džeronimo Stilton
programme.desc: Ime mu je Stilton, Džeronimo Stilton. Pisac u zemlji glodara, koji piše najbolje priče! Očaravajući, neverovatan glavni urednik koji je i veliki avantrurista! U tri reči: humor, avantura i ...humor! Doživljaji malog, pametnog miša, Džeronima Stiltona su puni uzbuđenja, akcije i sve to začinjeno sa malo humora. Naravno, to ne znači da se naši junaci ne upetljavaju u razne opasne situacije iz kojih se ipak uvek uspešno izvlače i izlaze kao pobednici. Džeronimovi drugari i članovi porodice pomažu mu da savlada prepreke i da uspešno istražuje i zajedno su za sve sposobni. Ponekad, ipak dolazi do nesuglasica i to prouzrokuje smešne situacije, ali se na kraju svi pomire, jer se bezuslovno.

programme.title: Zoro
programme.desc: Naša nova serija predstavlja tinejdžera Don Dijega, koji se suočava sa najvećim životnim izazovom boreći se za pravdu protiv brojnih bezobzirnih tirana! Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom "Z".

programme.desc: Bug i Eliot se zbližavaju sa Dinom i njegovom bandom oposuma, uzbudljivim, ali sumnjivim likovima. Privučeni sjajem televizije, video igara i ukusne nezdrave hrane, ne primećuju šta se zaista dešava.
